name: Hsin Kuang Steel Company Limited
summary: Hsin Kuang Steel Company Limited engages in the cutting, stamping, and sale of various steel products in Taiwan. It operates through Steel, Construction Projects, and Leases segments. The company's products portfolio includes steel coils and plates, round steel bars, stainless and alloy steel, special steel, and SuperDyma. It also involved in the investment in various businesses comprising manufacturing, securities investment, banking, insurance, etc.; sale of metal products for architecture; manufacture and sale of metal products and energy related equipment; and leasing and warehousing activities.
